hypothesis: A name-blind one-shot rule compiled from the three-cell taxonomy is not a complete agent decision procedure. Empirical gold is menu-relative representability. If every held-out row matches, surgery_holds. A miss is surgery_killed. Either verdict passes CI.

controls.description: decide() reads only Signature. Task and screen names are withheld from the policy.
Gold is which menu action repairs, not which taxonomy cell we intended when writing the row.
Construction rows are the authoring toys. They cannot save a held-out miss.
pair_eq + q_id has a nontrivial symmetry and no cheaper registered screen.
A surgery_killed verdict is a valid passing run.

gates.criterion: At least four construction rows and four held-out rows.
The repair menu has at least three screens.
The policy input is only the five Signature fields.
The held-out affine cycle mismatches Kirchhoff.
The verdict is surgery_holds or surgery_killed.
The run does not claim text nomination, an LLM eval, or Paper F.
